key_insight: Across 54 studies of ambient AI scribes, researchers found 40 metrics measured 96 different ways, limiting comparison and evidence synthesis.
clinical_relevance: Evaluating ambient AI scribes requires looking beyond documentation time to patient outcomes, safety, workload redistribution, and downstream note use.
method: Reviewed 54 recent evaluation studies of ambient AI scribes.
Mapped study designs, data sources, and metrics across 10 evaluation dimensions.
Examined inconsistencies and gaps in evaluation practices.
evidence_signal: Documentation efficiency and time appeared in 44 of 54 studies, while 35 of 96 metric operationalizations (36%) appeared in only one study.
watch_item: Heavy reliance on self-report and limited assessment of safety and clinical outcomes leave important effects uncertain.
paper_title: Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
